rule: Default plugins must never silently replace a claimed real result with fabricated/example data. Simulations and generative fiction are allowed only when the product surface explicitly says what they are.

doge_core.source: AstrBot runtime, OS, local aggregate counters

doge_math.source: local algorithms; OEIS/pi remote services where selected

doge_misc.source: local codec, Open-Meteo, NASA APOD/API page, Bing, OneBot action
doge_misc.fallback: real alternate source or explicit error

doge_typeset.fallback: alternate real renderer or explicit error

doge_playground.source: local numerical/visual algorithms; /fourier uses user image/SVG/text -> contour extraction -> complex DFT epicycles
doge_playground.fallback: explicit error; /fourier never substitutes a generic FFT spectrum

doge_papers.fallback: another real registry or explicit error

doge_games.source: local game engines; RNG is game state, not claimed real-world data

doge_arena.source: 238 exact v4 /wp cards + explicit arena modifiers + configured chat provider for narration
doge_arena.fallback: no replacement cards; provider failure is explicit

doge_social.source: pinned AstrBot meme-generator, tagged meme library, and group-chat air-reading plugins
doge_social.fallback: fail closed by group allow-list; explicit engine error instead of simulated output

doge_linguistics.source: Tangut dictionary/Yindian/RRPL/pinned Cthuvian translator; Tangut exact output is dictionary-grounded and relaxed completion can only select existing dictionary candidates or omit function words. Cthuvian formal forward commands accept English only; for natural-language non-English requests, the ambient Agent itself performs the faithful English translation before invoking the command, with no separate translation-model call. High register resolves English word-by-word against pinned RC-1 resources; all genuinely missing single English words are proposed together in one ordered structured DeepSeek batch, validated independently, then committed atomically.
doge_linguistics.fallback: Tangut relaxed output remains provenance-labeled. Cthuvian low register may use reversible sealed encoding; Cthuvian high register has no sealed/chunk/lexical fallback, and any unresolved batch proposal fails closed without partial registry writes.

doge_media.source: AnimeTrace or pinned local mirage algorithm

doge_code.fallback: protocol change/error is explicit; never execute on host

doge_lookup.fallback: another labeled real source or explicit error

doge_ai.source: pinned micrograd/minBPE; user-input/local generated experiment data

doge_chaoli.source: chaoli.club via local selective VLESS proxy and curl_cffi Chrome-compatible HTTP fingerprint; search uses Chaoli/esoTalk native POST AJAX with page session/token; theme cards require ID/channel consistency and separately bind first author vs last replier; floor parser uses real displayed floor numbers, preserves deleted-floor placeholders, and separates blockquote authors/content from current-floor text; user names are verified against real profile titles and activities bind profile/action/post/time before output
doge_chaoli.fallback: fail closed on unknown/mismatched board, inconsistent theme/card IDs, ambiguous duplicate usernames, unavailable pages, or unbound activity records; no nickname-to-real-identity inference, no cross-author quote flattening, no silent board fallback, and no synthetic search/index result is presented as native forum fact

doge_pixiv.source: MIT-vendored GetPx Lolicon v2 client/downloader subset; metadata from api.lolicon.app with r18=0 and excludeAI=true; local second-pass rejects x_restrict!=0 and ai_type=2; image bytes are downloaded through the Lolicon-returned or configured GetPx-compatible mirror route, currently verified with i.pixiv.re, then validated by Pillow before sending
doge_pixiv.fallback: no Pixiv-official direct connection is required; if Lolicon metadata or all allowed mirror downloads fail, return an explicit error rather than fabricate artwork metadata or silently substitute unrelated images
